craft_notes: Sthāyin: Giving and receiving (audārya); gifts moving both ways. End-dash→colon (all let be, maker lands). Rejected: 'free' for 'unbound' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: At each emprise, Bhava — deed, tool, cosmos be as they be:
the unbound maker there is thee alone.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān

reads_against.argmap: In every undertaking, O Bhava — act or means-and-rest or all, let be. → Amid all acts and means, you alone are the free doer.
c1_essence: Free doer alone amid all acts; seized worlds need none else's might or mercy.
reads_against.c1_rasa: bhakti with audārya (generosity tasted and returned)

l2.plain_english: Let every venture start, O Bhava — deed, instrument, world, what you will — yet the deed's free master there is you alone.
l2.sanskrit_cite: ārambhe bhava sarvatra karma vā karaṇādi vā viśvam astu svatantras tu kartā tatraikako bhavān

l3: At each emprise, Bhava — deed, tool, cosmos be as they be —

reads_against.t1: In every undertaking, O Bhava — act or means-and-rest or all, let be — but the free doer therein alone is you.
